connector.name: Voyagier
connector.registryDescription: Book real travel from your agent - flights, hotels & activities behind a price-gated checkout.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cli. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.voyagier, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VOYAGIER_TOKEN
env.description: Voyagier Personal Access Token (travel.voyagier.com → Settings → Personal Access Tokens). Access is by invitation — request at https://www.voyagier.com/agents.

env.name: VOYAGIER_API_URL
env.description: Voyagier API base URL. Defaults to production; override only for non-production environments.
